<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$user = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$created = WP_Application_Passwords::create_new_application_password( $user->ID, array( 'name' => 'Hermes e2e harness' ) );
if ( is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
	file_put_contents( '/e2e-run/creds.error', $created->get_error_message() );
	return;
}
$out = array(
	'url'          => untrailingslashit( home_url() ),
	'user'         => $user->user_login,
	'app_password' => $created[0],
	'admin_password' => 'password',
	'created_at'   => gmdate( 'c' ),
);
file_put_contents( '/e2e-run/creds.json', json_encode( $out, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES ) );
